name: Scratch App
description: The reference third-party app: its own tools, its own memory, the core panels it places.

tools.name: note_progress
tools.title: Note progress
tools.description: Records a short progress note in the app's own per-session memory.

tools.name: slow_echo
tools.title: Slow echo
tools.description: Echoes text back after a delay, reporting progress while it waits.

cards.title: Coding, in a conversation
cards.text: Point it at a folder and it reads what is there, runs what you agree to, and writes the change back.

rows.title: Your folder, your commands
rows.text: Every command runs in the folder this conversation is about.

rows.title: Nothing changes unasked
rows.text: A command that writes waits for your press.

cards.title: Files, changes and a terminal
cards.text: The panel beside the conversation holds the three views this app places there.

rows.title: Read the change as a diff
rows.text: Every file it touched, side by side with what was there before.

rows.title: It remembers this session
rows.text: Progress notes stay with the conversation they were written in.
